article_content: A Staten Island mother who suffered unimaginable loss during Superstorm Sandy has shared her story as the disaster's one-year anniversary approaches. Glenda Moore, 40, lost her sons Connor (4) and Brandon (2) when floodwaters swept them from her arms during evacuation attempts. The family has since relocated to Brooklyn, seeking solace near relatives while navigating their grief. Moore recounted the traumatic events to WABC this week, describing how her vehicle stalled amid rising waters on Father Capodanno Boulevard. Despite her efforts to carry both children to safety, powerful waves separated them during the storm's peak. The boys' bodies were later recovered 100 feet apart in marshland near their neighborhood. Now working as a nurse and planning to rebuild their family, Moore and her husband Damian emphasize the importance of staying occupied. 'We think about them constantly,' she shared, noting they're currently house-hunting in Marine Park while commemorating their children's memory.

Семејството се пресели во Бруклин, барајќи утеха близу роднините. Мур ги опиша трауматските настани за WABC оваа недела, објаснувајќи како нејзиниот автомобил се заглавуваше меѓу растечките води на булеварот Фатер Каподјано. И покрај напорите да ги спаси децата, моќните бранови ги разделија за време на најсилниот дел од бурата. Телата на момчињата беа пронајдени на 30 метри растојание во мочурливиот предел. Работејќи како здравствена сестра и планирајќи ново семејство, Мур и нејзиниот сопруг Дамјан истакнуваат дека работата им помага да се издржат. 'Постојано мислиме на нив,' изјави таа, велејќи дека моментално бараат нов дом во Марин Парк додека ги одбележуваат спомените на децата.

article_content: A teenage driver's reckless actions led to tragedy when uninsured Jay Gilbert, then 17, caused a fatal collision near Sleaford, Lincolnshire. After crashing his Suzuki Swift into a van while improperly exiting a junction last October, Gilbert abandoned his critically injured friend Joshua Reed at the scene. Despite witnesses immediately calling emergency services, 18-year-old Reed succumbed to his injuries within minutes. Gilbert compounded the trauma by falsely assuring Reed's parents their son survived, delaying their discovery of the truth for two hours. Recent court proceedings revealed Gilbert had falsely claimed to possess a valid driver's license prior to the incident. Lincoln Crown Court sentenced the now 18-year-old to 27 months in a youth detention facility with a three-month driving ban. The victim's father, Michael Reed, expressed anguish over his son dying alone while Gilbert fled, stating: 'He should've stayed to comfort Josh in his final moments.' Prosecutors noted Gilbert's lack of basic driving knowledge, including requirements for learner plates and supervised driving. Court documents also revealed Gilbert suffered a re-broken arm during community retaliation following the crash.

Откако неговиот 'Suzuki Swift' се удри во комбе при погрешна маневра минатата октомври, Гилберт го напушти тешко повредениот пријател Џошуа Рид на местото на несреќата. Обвинителите истакнаа дека Гилберт немаше основно знаење за сообраќајните правила, вклучувајќи ги условите за 'L' таблички и надзор при возење. Судските документи открија дека Гилберт повторно ја скршил раката при одмазда од заедницата по несреќата.

article_content: Kosara Mladenovic was mistakenly declared deceased by the Social Security Administration following her husband's recent death. Vaso Pavlovic, her son-in-law, received a perplexing letter at his New York home from the agency offering condolences for his mother-in-law's supposed passing - despite her being alive. A keystroke error incorrectly marked Mladenovic as deceased instead of her late husband (Pavlovic's father-in-law), according to CBS New York reports. The administration terminated Mladenovic's monthly benefits, which fund her nursing home care. 'They essentially erased her existence with a checkbox,' Pavlovic stated. CBS New York notes approximately 14,000 similar errors occur annually, though resolution proves complex. To reverse the error, Pavlovic must submit multiple documents including: a photo of Mladenovic holding current newspapers, nursing home residency confirmation, her husband's death certificate, and his published obituary. Elder care advocate Gideon Schein explained: 'Correcting these errors is harder than making them. While Social Security protections are necessary, the burden on families becomes overwhelming.' The agency acknowledged Pavlovic's case and initiated corrective actions, maintaining that documentation requirements prevent fraud and identity theft.

Васил Павлович, нејзиниот зет, доби збунувачко писмо во својот дом во Њујорк од агенцијата, со кое им се изрази сочувство за наводното починување на неговата свекрва - иако таа е сè уште жива. Грешка во внесувањето на податоци погрешно ја означи Младенович како почината наместо нејзиниот починат сопруг (таткото на Павлович), според извештаите на CBS New York. Агенцијата ги прекина месечните придобивки на Младенович, кои се користат за нејзината нега во дом за стари лица. 'Тие едноставно ја избришаа нејзината егзистенција со штиклирање на кутивче,' изјави Павлович. CBS New York наведува дека секоја година се случуваат околу 14.000 слични грешки, иако нивното исправување е сложено. За да ја поништи грешката, Павлович мора да поднесе повеќе документи вклучувајќи: фотографија на Младенович која држи тековни весници, потврда за престој во домот за стари лица, смртовницата на нејзиниот сопруг и неговиот објавен некролог. Застапникот за права на стари лица Гидеон Шајн објасни: 'Исправувањето на ваквите грешки е потешко отколку нивното направење. Иако заштитните мерки на Социјалното осигурување се неопходни, товарот врз семејствата станува преголем.' Агенцијата потврди дека го разгледала случајот на Павлович и презела корективни мерки, нагласувајќи дека барањата за документација се заштитна мерка против измами и кражба на идентитет.

article_content: Numerous parents experienced unnecessary distress when Wadebridge School in Cornwall erroneously distributed automated absence notifications on Monday afternoon. The alerts, typically triggered when students miss morning registration, were accidentally dispatched to hundreds of families around 2pm, prompting widespread alarm. Multiple guardians reported frantic attempts to contact the school through constantly engaged phone lines. Sharon Meehan, a local hotel worker, described her husband 'going mental' when they received the alert about their son Patrick. Gabriella Cleave recounted imagining worst-case scenarios when notified about her 12-year-old Jake's supposed absence, despite having seen him board the school bus. Initial school communications attributed the error to technical issues with the Truancy Call system, but subsequent investigation revealed human administrative mistakes. Headteacher Tina Yardley confirmed the false alerts occurred when an attendance officer improperly used the notification system while checking for messages. The school issued apologies approximately 20 minutes after the incident, though many parents reported ongoing communication difficulties. Affected families expressed mixed reactions, with some finding humor in the situation while others remained troubled by the implications. One anonymous parent noted: 'Even knowing your child's safe, that initial panic makes you question everything.' School officials have pledged to review notification protocols to prevent recurrence.

Директорката Тина Јардли потврди дека погрешното известување настана кога вработен погрешно го употреби системот додека проверуваше пораки. Училиштето испрати извинувања околу 20 минути по инцидентот, иако многу родители изјавија дека продолжија да имаат тешкотии во комуникацијата. Засегнатите семејства изразија мешани реакции, со некои кои најдоа хумор во ситуацијата додека други останаа загрижени. Еден анонимен родител истакна: 'Дури и да знаеш дека детето ти е безбедно, таа првична паника те натера да се сомневаш во се.' Школските власти ветија дека ќе ги ревидираат процедурите за известување за да спречат повторување.

article_content: Model and designer Kelly Brook has concluded her 18-year partnership with UK fashion retailer New Look. Reports in The Sun suggest the separation stems from brand concerns regarding Brook's relationship with David McIntosh, though her representatives cite career priorities in acting. Since 2006, Brook has designed multiple successful collections including swimwear and lingerie. The 35-year-old is currently focused on her Hollywood sitcom 'One Big Happy' and serves as ambassador for the New Atkins Nutritional Approach. Brook recently launched a plus-size clothing line (sizes 10-32) for Simply Be while maintaining her signature curves. Recent rumors suggest a new romance with model James Lee Taylor, whom she met during a Skechers campaign. New Look declined to comment on the separation.

article_content: Saudi Arabia and other Muslim countries demanded an immediate end to military operations in Gaza on Saturday, rejecting Israel's justification of actions as self-defense. The joint Organization of Islamic Cooperation and Arab League summit in Riyadh urged the International Criminal Court to investigate alleged 'war crimes and crimes against humanity' in Palestinian territories. Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman convened regional leaders, stating: 'We categorically reject this brutal conflict. The humanitarian disaster reveals the international community's failure to address Israeli violations of international law.' Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas characterized the situation as a 'genocidal war,' calling for U.S. intervention. Iranian President Ebrahim Raisi praised Hamas' resistance efforts, proposing economic measures: 'Islamic nations should impose oil and trade sanctions on Israel.' The conflict intensified following Hamas' October 7 attack that killed 1,200 Israelis. Gaza health authorities report 11,078 Palestinian casualties as of Friday, including 40% children, though these figures lack independent verification. Recent combat near Gaza City's Al-Shifa Hospital reportedly caused power failures resulting in patient deaths, according to Palestinian sources. The crisis has reshaped regional alliances, with Saudi Arabia engaging Iran despite longstanding tensions. Raisi's visit marked the first by an Iranian president in over a decade following their Chinese-mediated détente. Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan advocated for permanent ceasefire negotiations, while Qatari officials emphasized mediation efforts for hostage releases. Arab states displayed diverging positions on Israel relations - Algeria proposed severing ties, while normalization proponents stressed maintaining dialogue channels. Israeli PM Benjamin Netanyahu condemned Hamas as part of Iran's 'terror network,' urging Arab leaders to oppose the group.
translated_content: Саудиска Арабија и други муслимански земји побараа итно прекин на воените операции во Газа во саботата, отфрлајќи ги израелските оправдувања за самоодбрана. Заедничкиот самит на Организацијата за исламска соработка и Арапската лига во Ријад повика Меѓународниот кривичен суд да истражи наводни 'воени злосторства и злосторства против човештвото' во палестинските територии. Саудискиот престолонаследник Мухамед бин Салман ги собра регионалните лидери, изјавувајќи: 'Категорично го отфрламе овој брутален судир. Хуманитарната катастрофа ја открива неспособноста на меѓународната заедница да ги реши израелските кршења на меѓународното право.' Палестинскиот претседател Махмуд Абас ја опиша ситуацијата како 'геноцидна војна', барајќи американско посредување. Иранскиот претседател Ебрахим Раиси ја пофали отпорноста на Хамас, предложувајќи економски мерки: 'Исламските земји треба да воведат нафтени и трговски санкции против Израел.' Судирот ескалира по нападот на Хамас на 7 октомври кој однесе 1.200 израелски животи. Палестинските здравствени власти пријавија 11.078 жртви во Газа до петокот, вклучувајќи 40% деца, иако овие бројки немаат независна потврда. Скорешните борби кај болницата Ал-Шифа во Гава Сити наводно предизвикаа прекин на струја што доведе до смртни случаи кај пациенти, според палестински извори. Кризата ги преобрази регионалните сојузи, при што Саудиска Арабија воспостави контакти со Иран и покрај долгогодишните тензии. Посетата на Раиси беше прва на ирански претседател во над една деценија по нивниот кинески-посредуван договор. article_content: By Ian Drury | Updated: 19:36 EST, 31 July 2013 The family of Corporal Russell Aston, among six Royal Military Policemen killed in Iraq in 2003, is pursuing a £250,000 negligence claim against the UK Ministry of Defence. This follows a June 2023 Supreme Court ruling extending human rights protections to military personnel in conflict zones. The soldiers were ambushed by 500 locals while training police in Majar al Kabir. A 2006 inquest confirmed they had insufficient ammunition, malfunctioning radios, and no satellite phones. Legal documents allege commanders failed to provide essential equipment and safety measures. John Miller, father of deceased Corporal Simon Miller, stated: 'We seek accountability for operational failures identified in the official inquiry. While nothing restores our loss, an admission of guilt would help us rebuild our lives.' An MoD spokesperson declined to comment on ongoing legal proceedings but affirmed: 'Our sympathies remain with the bereaved families.'

article_content: Court documents reveal Farrah Fawcett maintained an 11-year relationship with college sweetheart Greg Lott while remaining publicly associated with Ryan O'Neal until her 2009 death. The revelation emerged during a legal dispute over ownership of an Andy Warhol portrait series featuring the actress. Lott testified under oath about their romantic relationship from 1998-2009, contradicting public perceptions of Fawcett's ongoing connection with O'Neal. Though Fawcett and O'Neal co-parented son Redmond after their 1997 separation, Lott claims he was Fawcett's primary partner during her final decade. Court records show Redmond was temporarily released from custody in 2009 under supervised conditions. The deposition references a 2007 letter from Fawcett to Lott and accounts of their discreet meetings. Lott attributes their privacy concerns to protecting Redmond and avoiding renewed media attention, stating: 'We didn't want to relive that level of fame.' O'Neal's representatives deny Lott's claims as 'categorically false.' The ongoing legal battle centers on a Warhol artwork from a series of four portraits that Fawcett bequeathed to University of Texas, which O'Neal contests.

article_content: A Target employee died by suicide three days after being accused of theft at his workplace. Graham Gentles, a 22-year-old from Pasadena, California diagnosed with Asperger's syndrome, was reportedly handcuffed and escorted through the store on July 15, 2022, despite no charges being filed. Gentles died on July 18 after jumping from a Monrovia hotel. His mother Virginia has filed a lawsuit alleging Target's 'walk of shame' practice contributed to his death. Court documents state Gentles was detained by police and store management without evidence of theft, then walked through the store while restrained. The complaint links this incident to his suicide, citing exacerbated distress from his neurodivergent condition. Target declined to comment due to ongoing litigation. The lawsuit seeks policy changes and damages, with Virginia stating: 'I don't want any other parent to experience this loss.'

article_content: A devastating early morning fire in Greenville, Kentucky claimed the lives of eight children and their mother, with freezing temperatures potentially contributing to the tragedy. The Watson family home was destroyed in a blaze investigators suspect originated from an electrical baseboard heater during record-low temperatures of 1°F. Father Chad Watson (36) and 11-year-old daughter Kylie escaped with severe burns and smoke inhalation, now in critical but stable condition at Vanderbilt University Medical Center's trauma unit. The victims include mother Larae Watson (35) and children Madison (15), Kaitlyn (14), Morgan (13), Emily (9), Samuel (8), Raegan (6), and 4-year-old twins Mark and Nathaniel. Firefighters found the single-story home fully engulfed when responding to a 2am emergency call. Neighbor Laura Bennett recalled 8-year-old Samuel playing with her daughter hours before the fatal incident. Officials confirmed no signs of foul play but noted the extreme cold as a potential factor in heater operation. Greenville Mayor Ed DeArmond declared a community day of mourning, while Kentucky Senator Mitch McConnell pledged support for recovery efforts. The tragedy underscores heating safety challenges in rural areas during severe weather.

article_content: A Minnesota father faced an unimaginable tragedy when a fire engulfed his Minneapolis duplex on February 14, 2014, amid subzero temperatures reaching -18°C (0°F). Widower Troy Lewis, 60, rescued two daughters - Shaca (9) and Electra (5) - but lost five other children aged 19 months to 8 years. Lewis, hospitalized with back injuries from jumping from a second-story window, described his harrowing decisions: 'I had to choose between a dead child here or...a live one.' The fire originated on the duplex's second floor around 4:30 AM, with investigators examining a space heater found onsite. The 102-year-old building had functioning smoke detectors and received renewed rental licensing on February 7, 2014, after addressing prior code violations. Fifteen residents occupied the property managed by Paul Bertelson's company, which specializes in refurbished housing for low-income families. Fire Chief John Fruetel confirmed three immediate fatalities, with two later deaths confirmed by the medical examiner. Forty firefighters battled the -18°C blaze for 2.5 hours, with one sustaining minor injuries. Neighbor Brandi Craig recounted hearing children's screams before silence fell: 'Once they stopped screaming, it was over.' Minneapolis Public Schools confirmed two victims attended Bethune Community School. The Red Cross is assisting seven displaced residents, including Lewis who remains hospitalized in stable condition. Governor Mark Dayton praised responders' heroism while community members mourned the devastating loss.

Вдовецот Трој Луис (60 години) успеа да спаси две ќерки - Шака (9) и Електра (5) - но загуби пет деца на возраст од 19 месеци до 8 години. Луис, хоспитализиран поради повреди од скокање од прозор, изјави: 'Морав да изберам помеѓу мртво дете и живо...' Пожарот избувна на вториот кат околу 4:30 наутро, при што се испитува улогата на грејач. Зградата од 1922 година имаше работачки детектори за дим и обновена упатна дозвола на 7 февруари, по отстранување на претходни недостатоци. Во објектот на Пол Бертелсон, кој нуди ревитализирани домови за сиромашни семејства, живееа 15 лица. Шефот на пожарникарите Џон Фрутел потврди три непосредни жртви, додека легалот утврди уште две. Четириесет пожарникари се бореа со пожарот 2.5 часа на -18°C, со еден лесноповреден. Комшијата Бренди Крег рече: 'Кога криците престанаа, сè беше завршено.' Две од загинатите беа ученици во основното училиште Бетјун. Црвениот крст им помага на погодените, вклучувајќи го и Луис. Гувернерот Марк Дејтон ги пофали спасувачите, додека заедницата ја оплакуваше загубата на невините деца.

article_content: Public confidence in Prime Minister David Cameron and Chancellor George Osborne has plummeted to historic lows following March's contentious Budget. Growing Conservative backbench discontent highlights perceived leadership disconnection. Opposition parties show minimal gains, with Labour leader Ed Miliband at 18% public trust.

The three-year-old equine frequently joins Laura Potter's daughters, Lilly (5) and Lacey (2), for afternoon tea. Ms Smith, 52, notes Mr P has developed human-like behaviors through constant interaction. 'He alternates between acting like a grumpy elder and an excitable child,' she said. After finding him drinking from her mug, she began preparing his own tea, which he eagerly consumes. The house-trained horse accompanies Ms Smith around Middleton St George, including to shops and cafes, attracting public attention. Though his size limits equine interactions, Mr P socializes with Smith's 5ft 3in former racehorse Johnny and stays in a farm stable during mild weather. Ms Smith co-manages a pony rental business for community events and conducts therapeutic care home visits with Mr P. She emphasizes his accident-free record, maintained through training and a portable pink 'emergency' bucket.

article_content: Tennis star Juan Martin del Potro, currently ranked 7th globally, has joined Andy Murray in withdrawing from the upcoming French Open championship. The Argentine athlete cited a persistent viral infection that first emerged during his Rome Masters loss to Benoit Paire last week. This marks another setback for del Potro, who previously missed tournaments in Portugal and Madrid before attempting a comeback in Italy. 'This is devastating news as Roland Garros represents one of those career-defining tournaments,' del Potro stated on official ATP channels. The 2009 US Open champion emphasized his need to fully recover before future competitions. His withdrawal follows Murray's exit due to back problems, with both athletes now focusing on rehabilitation. Del Potro's Roman campaign included a memorable meeting with Pope Francis, an experience he described as 'unforgettable.' The athlete has historically performed well at Roland Garros, reaching semifinals in 2009 and quarterfinals in 2012, though Roger Federer halted both runs. In related news, Caroline Wozniacki's challenging season continued with a straight-set defeat against China's Zheng Jie at the Brussels Open. The Danish player, once ranked world No.1, has now suffered early exits from four consecutive tournaments. Zheng's victory proved particularly impressive given she'd already played a full match earlier that day, defeating American qualifier Mallory Burdette. 'Zheng's aggressive playstyle completely overwhelmed me,' Wozniacki admitted after the match. The Chinese athlete, who faces Switzerland's Romina Oprandi next, praised her opponent's resilience while expressing confidence in her own improved form ahead of Roland Garros.

article_content: Costa Rican authorities assessed earthquake damage Wednesday following a powerful 7.6-magnitude tremor along the northwest coast. President Laura Chinchilla described it as 'one of the strongest earthquakes' in national history while commending citizens' preparedness. The quake's epicenter near the Nicoya Peninsula occurred approximately 87 miles west of San Jose at a depth exceeding 28 miles. While officials reported no major structural damage, schools in affected areas will remain closed through Friday for safety inspections. Conflicting reports emerged regarding casualties - emergency responders initially cited one heart attack death, though Chinchilla later stated 'no human losses.' Local accounts described violent shaking causing merchandise to fall and ground movements. Infrastructure impacts included road debris, power outages, and partial bridge collapses, particularly within 14 kilometers (8 miles) of the epicenter. The Red Cross evacuated patients from two damaged medical facilities. Tsunami warnings were lifted hours post-quake. Seismologists noted this event aligned with long-standing predictions for the region.

Иако не се пријавени големи структурни оштетувања, училиштата во погодените области ќе останат затворени до петок за инспекции. Локалните сведоци опишаа силни тресења при кои паѓаа производи од полици и се чувствуваше движење на земјата. Штетите вклучуваат отпадоци на патишта, прекин на струја и делумно уривање на мостови, особено во радиус од 14 километри од епицентарот. Црвениот крст евакуира пациенти од две оштетени болници. article_content: A commercial airline pilot was hospitalized after a smuggled cocaine package ruptured during a flight from Colombia to Houston. Records indicate he's licensed to operate Boeing 737 aircraft, though his current employer remains unidentified. Aviation security protocols exempt flight crew from certain passenger screening procedures.

article_content: The University of North Carolina has acknowledged systemic failures in academic oversight that allowed students, particularly athletes, to enroll in substandard courses for years. Chancellor Carol Folt admitted these deficiencies during a recent trustees meeting, stating: 'We accept there was a failure in academic oversight that continued unchecked, which was wrong and damaged our integrity.' This admission follows a CNN investigation revealing ongoing academic issues, including some athletes reading at elementary school levels. The revelations come two years after UNC's fake-class scandal, where athletes received grades for phantom courses requiring only a single paper. One professor faces fraud charges for a non-existent class. While UNC previously claimed the scandal was isolated, Folt now recognizes broader systemic problems. University officials implemented 120 reforms after internal investigations but face new scrutiny following researcher Mary Willingham's findings that certain athletes struggled with basic reading comprehension. Executive Vice Chancellor James Dean has commissioned a study into the African and African-American Studies department where fake classes originated. UNC maintains an alert system for monitoring athlete class enrollment, though its effectiveness remains unverified. The NCAA found no rule violations but hasn't reopened its investigation. Notably, Bloomberg Businessweek's chairman serves as a UNC trustee.

Еден професор е обвинет за измама поради водење непостоечки курс. Додека UNC претходно го претстави скандалот како изолиран случај, Фолт сега признава пошироки системски проблеми. article_content: Pakistani authorities have freed 179 Indian fishermen detained for accidentally entering disputed waters, officials confirmed Saturday. The group - some held for over a year - will be transported from Karachi to Lahore before repatriation to India, according to Aslam Nasir Zahid of the Pakistan-India judicial committee, a non-governmental organization tracking civilian detentions. While this release marks progress, Zahid notes nearly 300 Indian fishermen remain in Pakistani jails alongside 480 seized vessels. Maritime border disputes between the neighbors routinely lead to arrests, with many detainees facing extended incarceration without formal charges. Pakistan Fisherfolk Forum's Mohammed Ali Shah highlighted reciprocal concerns, stating 41 Pakistani fishermen have been imprisoned in India for approximately 15 years.

Иако ова ослободување претставува напредок, Захид истакнува дека речиси 300 индиски рибари сè уште се во пакистанските затвори заедно со 480 запленети бродови. article_content: West Bromwich Albion has declined defender Craig Dawson's transfer request, club sources confirm. The 24-year-old's appeal coincides with new manager Alan Irvine's assessment of the squad inherited from Pepe Mel. This follows a similar rejection of George Thorne's transfer plea earlier this summer. Dawson, acquired from Rochdale in 2010, made 15 senior appearances last season - 12 in Premier League matches with 10 starts - primarily as backup to defenders McAuley and Olsson. While linked with Burnley, the recent signing of Joleon Lescott may further limit Dawson's first-team opportunities.

article_content: During a Miami interview with CNN's Hala Gorani, the Dalai Lama expressed his intention to retire, stating: 'As a human being, retirement is my right.' While not specifying a timeline, the octogenarian spiritual leader noted his advanced age makes departure inevitable. He affirmed support for recent Tibetan student protests against Mandarin-only university instruction, declaring: 'My true authority lies with Tibet's people - I must back their nonviolent movements.' The Nobel laureate reiterated calls for Chinese authorities to free imprisoned peace prize recipient Liu Xiaobo, revealing collaboration with fellow laureates including Desmond Tutu. Despite acknowledging world leaders' reluctance to meet him due to China relations, he dismissed concerns: 'It's unimportant if meetings cause inconvenience.' The spiritual leader emphasized prioritizing public engagement to advance human values and interfaith harmony. While admitting technological illiteracy, he praised social media's role in reaching closed societies, with staff managing his Twitter account for nearly one million followers. The interview concluded as he completed his North American speaking tour.

article_content: Sun worshippers enjoyed sustained warmth as Britain's heatwave continued through the weekend. After brief cooling to low 20s Celsius, temperatures rebounded with London and northern regions reaching 28°C. The Met Office reported Strathallan, Perthshire peaked at 28.4°C - Scotland's highest 2023 temperature. Safety warnings followed a 17-year-old's drowning in Worcestershire's Gullet Quarry. Emergency services addressed heat-related challenges including Merseyside grass fires, while zoos cooled animals with water sprays. Meteorologists forecast temperatures near 30°C could persist until Sunday with minimal rain expected.

article_content: CAMBRIDGE, MA - Harvard University's admissions landscape reflects broader changes in higher education, with early applications surging 41% above pre-pandemic levels as of fall 2023. The Supreme Court's affirmative action ruling and test-optional policies have increased opacity in admissions processes. The National Association for College Admissions Counseling (NACAC) reports 71% of responding institutions now weigh 'positive character attributes' heavily, while 44% prioritize demonstrated interest. Shriya Boppana, a Carnegie Mellon University graduate, combined campus visits with LinkedIn outreach to understand school cultures. 'Proactive adaptability matters across platforms,' she notes. UC Berkeley's Aaditya Agrawal succeeded through targeted email communication with engineering department representatives, proving digital outreach's effectiveness when executed thoughtfully. Experts recommend multifaceted networking strategies, emphasizing the Harvard Business Review's findings about networking's long-term benefits for first-generation students. As traditional metrics become less definitive, personal engagement emerges as a key differentiator in admissions decisions.

article_content: Frankie Dettori was reportedly disappointed after losing his ride on Treve, the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe favorite trained by Criquette Head-Maarek. However, Al Shaqab racing manager Harry Herbert confirmed this change won't affect Dettori's position as primary jockey for Sheikh Joaan Al Thani's racing stable. Veteran French rider Thierry Jarnet will take over riding duties starting with Sunday's Group 1 Prix Vermeille at Longchamp - a decision made by Head-Maarek based on Jarnet's successful history with Treve, including their 2013 Arc victory. Jarnet previously rode Treve during her first three races and the 2013 Arc win when Dettori sustained an ankle injury. While Dettori secured last year's Vermeille victory aboard Treve, their recent performances resulted in defeats, including a third-place finish at Royal Ascot's Prince of Wales's Stakes where the filly sustained muscle injuries. Herbert stated: 'Frankie understands the trainer's perspective. This decision reflects Criquette's confidence in Jarnet's morning workout performance with Treve.' Dettori will instead ride Al Shaqab's Osaila in Ireland's Moyglare Stud Stakes at The Curragh and the £5.25 million filly Al Namah at Chantilly next week. This marks the second significant mount loss for Dettori since 2012 when he missed riding Godolphin's St Leger winner Encke, leading to his departure from Sheikh Mohammed's operation.

article_content: New York (CNN) – The mother of Melissa Barthelemy, one of eight victims discovered near Long Island's Oak Beach, disclosed that an unidentified man used her daughter's phone to make threatening calls in 2009. Family attorney Steve Cohen stated the caller told Barthelemy's sister: 'You won't see her again. I killed her.' Seven calls occurred between July and August 2009, containing explicit content and derogatory remarks. Police obtained a journal documenting these communications, potentially aiding the serial killer profile. Cohen characterized the perpetrator as 'a calculating, stone-cold killer.' Four identified victims – Barthelemy, Maureen Brainard-Barnes, Amber Lynn Costello, and Megan Waterman – had advertised escort services online. Recent aerial searches in Nassau County detected suspicious materials, though no additional remains were verified. Authorities confirm no connection to 2006 New Jersey cases. The ongoing investigation has included federal agencies since December 2010.

Извршени се седум повици помеѓу јули и август 2009 со непристојни описи и навреди. Полицијата доби дневник со записи од повиците, што може да помогне во создавање профил на серискиот убиец. Коен го опиша сторителот како 'пресметлив и безмилосен убиец.' Четири идентификувани жртви – Бартелеми, Морин Брејнард-Барнс, Амбер Лин Костело и Меган Вотерман – нуделе ескорт услуги преку интернет. Скорешни пребарувања со авиони открија сомнителни материјали во Насо Каунти, но без нови откритија на останки. Властите негираа врска со случаи од Њу Џерси во 2006. Истрагата со федерална соработка трае од декември 2010.

Ashley McDaniel, 26, was found unconscious in an Ocean Springs Economy Inn motel room alongside three men. Police discovered five grams of marijuana, methamphetamine, and drug paraphernalia during a search. McDaniel faces child neglect and marijuana possession charges. Dustin Yates, 32, was charged with paraphernalia possession and had an outstanding warrant. The child was placed in protective custody with the Department of Human Services.

article_content: The Netherlands and Mexico made World Cup history as the first teams to utilize official cooling breaks during their match in Fortaleza, Brazil, where temperatures reached 39°C. FIFA's new safety protocol mandated three-minute hydration pauses at the 30th and 75th minutes when pitch-level temperatures exceed 32°C. The extreme conditions sparked renewed debate about Qatar's suitability as 2022 World Cup hosts, where summer temperatures often approach 45°C. Medical teams monitor real-time conditions at each venue, with referees authorized to pause matches for player safety. Netherlands coach Louis van Gaal credited the second cooling break with enabling tactical adjustments that led to their 2-1 victory. 'Changing to Plan B during the break proved decisive,' he stated. Mexican manager Miguel Herrera maintained his formal attire throughout the match despite the heat. FIFA's climate adaptation measures include mandatory hydration protocols, with players potentially losing up to 4kg (equivalent to 4 liters) through fluid loss during matches. Former England defender Rio Ferdinand humorously mirrored the players' experience by posting a selfie with a cooling drink. While Qatar proposes moving the 2022 tournament to winter months with temperatures between the mid-20s and 30s (°C), concerns persist about extreme heat risks and sandstorms during traditional summer scheduling.

article_content: T-Mike Kliebert (29) of Hammond, Louisiana, is teaching his five-year-old son Blaise the art of alligator wrestling, continuing a family tradition at the world's oldest gator farm. Established in the 1930s by grandfather Harvey Kliebert and currently operated by father Michael Kliebert, the facility houses 2,500 alligators, including a 15-foot specimen weighing over 1,000 pounds. 'This isn't just a job - it's our heritage,' says T-Mike, who began handling reptiles as a child. While Blaise proclaims he wants to 'be tough like Daddy,' mother Sara Bordelon (27) acknowledges the inherent risks: 'He's been bitten multiple times. It's scary, but this is their legacy.' The farm sustains itself through alligator meat/skin sales and educational tours. T-Mike emphasizes safety: 'We respect these predators. Proper training prevents accidents.' Despite critics calling it dangerous, he maintains: 'This is my passion and livelihood.'

article_content: By David Martosko, U.S. Political Editor. Senator John McCain stated Thursday there would be 'hell to pay' if Russian forces or pro-Russian separatists in Ukraine were responsible for downing Malaysia Airlines Flight 17. 'This aircraft was approaching Russian airspace,' the Arizona Republican told MSNBC. 'While not conclusive, the incident bears hallmarks of mistaken identity, potentially being misidentified as a Ukrainian military plane.' McCain warned of 'significant consequences' if investigations confirm Russian-backed forces' involvement. Recovery teams worked through a 9-mile debris field containing wreckage, personal belongings, and human remains near Shaktarsk in eastern Ukraine. All 298 aboard perished. The senator criticized the U.S. response to the Ukraine crisis, stating: 'Ukrainian forces have repeatedly requested defensive weapons they haven't received.' He described sanctions against Russia as 'insufficient relative to Crimea's annexation.' Russian President Vladimir Putin denied involvement, calling accusations 'baseless' while blaming Ukraine. U.S. officials confirmed the plane was struck by a Russian-made surface-to-air missile, with AP reporting Soviet-era 'Buk' missile systems were present in separatist-controlled areas.

article_content: Westminster Abbey unveils plans for its first major architectural addition in nearly three centuries - a £19 million Gothic-inspired tower that will provide public access to previously restricted historical spaces. The project, approved by local authorities this week, transforms the eastern Triforium gallery into The Queen's Diamond Jubilee Galleries, scheduled to open in early 2018. Visitors will encounter rare artifacts spanning centuries of British history, including the 14th-century Liber Regalis manuscript and ceremonial robes worn during Charles II's coronation. The tower design by surveyor Ptolemy Dean maintains Gothic architectural elements while remaining discreetly integrated with the Abbey's existing structure. This development continues Henry III's original 13th-century vision for the space, which remained unrealized until now. The new galleries will offer unprecedented views of the Abbey's interior while displaying treasures from royal effigies to medieval stonework. Council officials praised the project as enhancing London's cultural landscape while preserving historical integrity, with construction completion anticipated in early 2018.

article_content: Terry Deary's Horrible Histories series, having educated and entertained children worldwide through vivid depictions of history's most gruesome moments for over two decades, will conclude with its 60th publication. The author announced Deadly Days in History as the final installment, citing creative saturation: 'It's had a better run than most children's series. I want it to end before being taken for granted.' Since its 1993 debut with The Rotten Romans, the series has sold over 25 million copies across 40 countries, inspiring BAFTA-winning TV adaptations and stage productions. Deary, who received a C in O-level and E in A-level history, revolutionized children's historical education by emphasizing bizarre and macabre details. His upcoming projects include a four-part adult history series covering the Roman Empire through Victorian era.

article_content: (CNN) — Venezuelan President Hugo Chavez announced during a televised address Thursday that Cuban doctors successfully removed a cancerous tumor discovered during his medical treatment. While confirming he continues to receive care, Chavez did not disclose the tumor's location, specific therapies, or his return timeline to Venezuela. The tumor containing malignant cells was identified following an initial procedure for a pelvic abscess, according to Chavez. Subsequent surgery removed the growth without complications, with the president stating he's undergoing 'complementary therapies' and that his recovery progresses satisfactorily. Chavez delivered a 15-minute prepared speech flanked by national symbols, displaying uncharacteristic restraint compared to his typical lengthy extemporaneous addresses. 'I've historically neglected health checkups,' he admitted, tracing current issues to symptoms first noticed during an official Cuba visit this month. Vice President Elias Jaua later appeared on state television urging unity: 'This moment demands reflection and work, not sadness.' The address marked Chavez's first appearance since emergency surgery three weeks ago, with his prolonged Cuban stay fueling health speculation. Concerns intensified after Venezuela postponed July's regional summit, citing recovery needs. While allies denied cancer diagnoses, state TV aired footage showing Chavez conversing with Fidel Castro — images officials cited as proof of recovery progress.

article_content: A Gloucester man with a 30-year criminal history has been sentenced to his fifth prison term following his 200th burglary conviction. Nathan Hibberd, 39, became emotional during proceedings at Gloucester Crown Court where Judge Jamie Tabor QC questioned the likelihood of rehabilitation. Court documents show Hibberd's burglary pattern began in 1992, with four prior convictions resulting in prison sentences totaling over 15 years. His latest offenses occurred in July 2013, when police arrested him after residential break-ins in Kingsholm and Wotton. A public alert led to Hibberd's capture after Tuffley residents spotted him hiding in a garden. Judge Tabor acknowledged the victims' trauma, stating: 'Homeowners' descriptions of fear and violation appear completely warranted.' While imposing concurrent 3.5-year sentences, the judge stressed personal accountability: 'Sustainable change requires your own commitment. Institutional measures alone can't break this pattern.' The court ordered a £150 victim surcharge alongside the prison term.

article_content: Chinese stunt driver Han Yue has claimed a new parallel parking world record by maneuvering into a space measuring just 3.15 inches (8 cm) larger than his vehicle's dimensions. The precision driving feat occurred at the China Drift Championship in Chongqing, where Yue slid his Mini 3-door hatchback into position with only 1.575 inches of clearance on each side. This achievement surpasses British driver Alistair Moffatt's 2013 record of 3.4-inch clearance by 0.6 centimeters. Automotive experts previously considered Moffatt's record unbeatable. Yue, who held the title before losing it to Moffatt in July 2013, executed the parking maneuver using a controlled power drift technique. Video documentation shows Yue approaching the space at moderate speed, executing a sharp handbrake turn to align the vehicle, then sliding precisely into position. The new record continues a trend of rapidly improving parking precision - the 2012 benchmark required 8.26 inches of space. Yue accelerated his attempt to Friday due to anticipated weekend rainfall in Chongqing. In a secondary achievement, Yue collaborated with stunt driver Zhang Shengjun to set the Guinness World Record for 'most donut spins (360-degree rotations) around a car moving on two wheels.' Yue stated his motivation was to restore China's position in motorsport records and demonstrate national driving expertise.

Овој подвиг се случи на Првенството во дрифт на Кина во Чунгкинг, каде Јуе го паркира својот Mini хечбек со 3 врати во простор со само 1.575 инчи од секоја страна. Kopitar praised Chris's team presence, telling reporters: 'He feels like a brother to me. During long seasons, he lifts our spirits by joking around and playing basketball with us.' Coach Darryl Sutter discussed his family's connection to the Down syndrome community in a Toronto Sun interview, noting: 'I feel responsible to support other families facing similar challenges. article_content: The fatal shooting of unarmed 18-year-old Michael Brown in Ferguson on August 9, 2014, has intensified decades-long racial tensions between law enforcement and the community. In this St. Louis suburb, where 67% of the 21,000 residents identify as African American, the 53-member police department includes only three Black officers. A 2013 report from Missouri Attorney General Chris Koster revealed African Americans faced twice the arrest rate of white individuals during traffic stops. Residents describe systemic discrimination through the phrase 'DWB' (Driving While Black). Official data shows African Americans accounted for 86% of Ferguson's 2013 traffic stops despite being 67% of the population, with The Washington Post reporting 92% of those stops resulted in arrests. The NAACP filed a federal complaint in 2013 against St. Louis County Police regarding arrest disparities, coinciding with reports of a former lieutenant directing officers to target Black residents. Police Chief Thomas Jackson acknowledged institutional failures, stating: 'There's been this undertow that's surfaced. Enhancing diversity and community relations are immediate priorities.' However, local resident Corey Crawford expressed skepticism: 'Finding trust in police here is like seeking a four-leaf clover.' Conflicting narratives surround Brown's death. Police report a physical altercation preceding the shooting, while witnesses claim Brown surrendered with raised hands. Protests continue under the slogan 'Hands up! Don't shoot!' as tensions flare between armored officers and demonstrators. Independent reviews by UCLA researchers and cyber activism by Anonymous highlight national scrutiny of Ferguson's systemic challenges.

Независни истражувачи и кибер-активисти ја истакнуваат потребата од системски промени во Фергусон.

article_content: North Korea risks triggering a nuclear disaster by reactivating its aging Yongbyon reactor, international experts warn. Satellite imagery from August 31 reveals steam emissions from the 1950s-design facility, indicating renewed operations of the plutonium-producing reactor that was shut down in 2007 under a disarmament agreement. Russian officials describe the reactor's 'nightmarish state', warning of potential catastrophic consequences. Analysis by the U.S.-Korea Institute confirms the facility - capable of producing 6kg of weapons-grade plutonium annually - appears operational despite violating UN Security Council resolutions. While Pyongyang cites national security needs, global leaders condemn the reactivation. In a contrasting diplomatic development, North and South Korea agreed to trial-reopen the Kaesong Industrial Complex, demonstrating complex inter-Korean relations amid nuclear tensions.

article_content: The United States Central Command has released four new videos documenting coalition strikes against Islamic State targets in Syria and Iraq. The footage, available on Centcom's official YouTube channel, shows precision attacks destroying militant vehicles and infrastructure. One sequence depicts the destruction of an ISIS-operated tank in Iraq, while another shows a direct hit on a moving vehicle. Additional strikes targeted an ISIS-occupied building near Syria's Al-Hasaka border region and a weapons storage facility. Military analysts confirm ISIS has adopted new tactics, including using motorcycles instead of military convoys and implementing communication restrictions to evade detection. Charles Lister from Brookings Doha Centre identified an operational '#MediaSecrecyCampaign' in Arabic, implemented after UK parliamentary approval of airstrikes, restricting fighters' digital footprint. Recent reports from the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights detail ISIS beheadings of ten individuals near Kobani, including Kurdish defenders and civilians. The ongoing conflict has displaced over 160,000 residents to Turkey, according to UN officials. Kurdish forces remain engaged in intense fighting against ISIS advances that began in mid-September.

article_content: Professional golfer Dustin Johnson has declared a temporary hiatus from competitive play to focus on mental health maintenance. The athlete, currently ranked 16th worldwide, withdrew from this week's WBC-Bridgestone Invitational and will skip both the upcoming PGA Championship in Valhalla and September's Ryder Cup in Scotland. Through an official statement, Johnson explained: 'Effective immediately, I'm stepping away from professional golf to address personal challenges through expert assistance. Dedicated time and resources toward improving my mental and physical health will help me achieve my full potential as a champion.' The 30-year-old eight-time PGA Tour winner, renowned for his driving power, stands fifth in U.S. player rankings. His absence creates a significant gap in Team USA's Ryder Cup lineup, where he maintained an undefeated 3-0 record during the 2012 Medinah competition. U.S. team captain Tom Watson acknowledged Johnson's value, stating: 'Dustin's absence will be noticeable, but our roster remains deep. His 2012 performance demonstrated exceptional skill.' Tiger Woods highlighted Johnson's athletic capabilities: 'His effortless 320-yard drives create unmatched competitive advantage - it's remarkable to observe.' Justin Rose, former U.S. Open champion, expressed support: 'I wish him well through this difficult time. His decision surprised many peers.' Johnson recently partnered with Rory McIlroy in the British Open's final round, finishing 12th. The golfer concluded by requesting privacy: 'I ask supporters and media to respect my need for confidentiality during this period of personal growth.'

Преку официјално соопштение, Џонсон објасни: 'Веднаш се повлекувам од професионалниот голф за да се справам со личните предизвици преку стручна помош. Вложувањето време и ресурси за подобрување на менталното и физичкото здравје ќе ми помогне да ја остварам целосната потенцијал како шампион.' article_content: At 17, I believed myself invincible like many teenage boys. Relocating from Bakersfield, California to North Carolina to pursue professional racing, I felt unstoppable—until unexpected symptoms emerged. During the move, I experienced rapid weight loss and unquenchable thirst despite excessive fluid intake, requiring frequent stops. Mood swings made me difficult companions. After returning to Bakersfield, my parents' physician diagnosed type 1 diabetes, declaring my racing career over. Devastated but defiant, I refused to accept this prognosis. Through research, we discovered Dr. Anne Peters, a diabetes specialist treating racer Charlie Kimball. Within a week, I began a rigorous diet and exercise regimen under Dr. Peters' guidance. This discipline enabled my 2012 ARCA Racing Series success and NASCAR Camping World Truck Series appearances. By 2013, I joined Roush Fenway Racing's development team while co-launching the Drive to Stop Diabetes campaign with the American Diabetes Association through Ryan's Mission foundation. My first top-10 NASCAR Nationwide finish occurred September 6, 2013, in the specially branded Ford Mustang. Ongoing races feature our diabetes awareness livery, combining athletic achievement with health advocacy. This journey demonstrates that diabetes, while challenging, doesn't preclude extraordinary accomplishment.
